package p

import (
	"runtime"
	"sync/atomic"
)

type shard struct {
	w    *dst.World
	left atomic.Int64
	done atomic.Bool
}

// evict makes its own progress: Gosched is a turn for others.
func (s *shard) evict() {
	for s.left.Add(-1) > 0 {
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
}

// wait spins until another goroutine sets done: Gosched is a spin.
func (s *shard) wait() {
	for !s.done.Load() {
		runtime.Gosched()
	}
}
